hosts.description: List of static host entries to configure in bootptab. Each entry maps a hostname/IP to boot parameters.

hostname.description: Hostname (DNS name or alias) of the client. Must be unique per entry.

ip.description: Static IP address to assign to this client (required for BOOTP/DHCP static mapping).

bootp_file.description: Path to the boot file (relative to TFTP root) to download during PXE/BOOTP. If empty, defaults to '/tftpboot/<hostname>'.

root_path.description: NFS root path for diskless clients. If empty, defaults to '/nfsroot/<hostname>'.

swap_path.description: NFS path for swap space. If empty, defaults to '/nfsroot/<hostname>/swap'.

core_dump_path.description: NFS path where core dumps should be stored. If empty, defaults to '/nfsroot/<hostname>/core'.

bootp_lease.description: Lease duration (in seconds) for BOOTP requests.

dhcp_lease.description: Lease duration (in seconds) for DHCP requests.

options.description: Additional BOOTP/DHCP options as key-value pairs (e.g., {'gateway': '192.168.1.1', 'dns_servers': '8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4'}).
